summary: Linear: the refinement's guard sample must not be a degenerate 1-row activation. The official calibration list ends with a 1-row entry, so `calibration[-1][0].shape[0] < 2` skipped the refinement entirely; the mirror puts that entry first and ran it. Guard on the last entry with >=2 rows. Official mini_sample Linear 0.382698 -> 0.423636 (+204.7 on 50 questions); a no-op where the last entry is already informative (the mirror).
patches:
if not calibration or int(calibration[-1][0].shape[0]) < 2:
        return parent
    # v626: the guard sample must not be a degenerate activation. The official
    # sample's calibration list ends with a 1-row activation ([10,128,512,1024,1]),
    # so the old test `calibration[-1][0].shape[0] < 2` returned the parent
    # untouched and the whole refinement was skipped -- while our mirror bank,
    # which puts the 1-row entry first, exercised it fully. Take the last entry
    # with at least two rows instead, so the guard is informative wherever it is
    # evaluated. On banks whose last entry is already informative this is a no-op.
    if not calibration:
        return parent
    guard = next((c for c in reversed(calibration)
                  if int(c[0].shape[0]) >= 2), None)
    if guard is None:
        return parent
        packed = calibration[-1]
        packed = guard
